catalog.name: FormPortal
catalog.summary: One place to install, open and update every Form app.

notes_for_owner: Since formportal 0.54.0 FormPortal releases its installers as they are, no zips: post_build runs setup/package_release.py per platform, which copies them to release-dist/formportal-<version>-<os>-<arch>.dmg (macOS), .AppImage, .deb and .rpm (Linux) and formportal-<version>-windows-<arch>-setup.exe (Windows), plus manifest-*.json and updater-*.json parts and, on macOS only, a signed formportal-<version>-macos-<arch>-update.app.tar.gz (on Linux and Windows latest.json points at the installer itself, which is the updater bundle). The notarize step also notarizes and staples the dmg the artifacts glob matches in release-dist, since post-build copies it before notarization, and --finish recomputes each manifest size and SHA-256 from the staged files; before 0.54.0 every platform was a formportal-<version>-<os>-<arch>.zip. The assets step (`--finish --out "$DIST"`) merges the parts into manifest.json, SHA256SUMS and latest.json and deletes the parts, so the artifacts glob must be release-dist/* (all of it). Overlap: formcompiler also writes SHA256SUMS.txt (both kept); formcompiler's own latest.json is only written when a .sig is staged beside an updater bundle, and release-dist holds none, so FormPortal's own latest.json from --finish is the one released and copied to formportal-updates and to formportal/updates/latest.json in the download store. stage.py appends _<arch> only to a *.app.tar.gz whose stem has no hyphen or underscore, so formportal-<v>-macos-arm64-update.app.tar.gz keeps its name and latest.json's macOS URLs match. Since formportal 0.53.4 the Windows build makes only the NSIS setup it ships (FORMPORTAL_BUNDLES overrides it for an msi), and the build scripts pin @tauri-apps/cli 2.12.3. Since formportal 0.53.5 the updater endpoint in its tauri.conf.json is https://dl.formai.studio/formportal/updates/latest.json (the download store's feed, which scripts/tauri_config.py also writes when FORMCOMPILER_PUBLIC_BASE is set), and --finish writes each platform URL as https://dl.formai.studio/formportal/<version>/<file>, so feed.py public leaves them unchanged; before 0.53.5 both named this repository's formportal-updates and formportal-v<version> releases. The updater public key comes from the FORMPORTAL_UPDATER_PUBKEY variable in the old workflow; tauri.conf.json has an empty pubkey, so formcompiler must supply the public half when it merges the config. The old release step also created the draft release with a fixed note; formcompiler's notes fall back to CHANGELOG.md. The package script's 'minimum_os' for Linux came from the build host's libc.
